content.title: Sabre (SABR): Profitability Forecast to Replace Losses—Earnings Growth Seen at 87.83% Per Year
content.summary: Sabre (SABR) remains unprofitable but has trimmed its losses at an average pace of 30.8% per year over the last five years. Looking ahead, earnings are projected to grow an impressive 87.83% each year, with the path to profitability expected within three years. Investors are watching whether this acceleration in earnings can offset a slower revenue growth outlook of 3.1% per year and recent share price volatility. See our full analysis for Sabre. content.title: SABR Q3 Deep Dive: Revenue Outpaces Expectations While Guidance and Margins Face Pressure
content.summary: Travel technology company Sabre (NASDAQ:SABR) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 3.5% year on year to $715.2 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $644.9 million was less impressive, coming in 3.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.01 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
